data.claim: The live code exposes four lane-process knobs (lanes.event_buffer, lanes.pass_env, lanes.scope, lanes.stop_grace_s) that the upgrade manifest replay() does not declare.
data.falsifier: replay() already containing lanes.event_buffer (the parity test passing) refutes the claim.
data.mechanism: UM.replay() rebuilds declared knobs from templates/upgrade/changes.toml plus unreleased/*.toml fragments; surface() reads the live registry. The four knobs shipped in the lane contract and process-headless driver commits but were never declared as fragments, so replay() falls behind the live code.
data.probe_output: FAILED AssertionError: Left contains 4 more items: {lanes.event_buffer:1000, lanes.pass_env:[...], lanes.scope:none, lanes.stop_grace_s:10}
data.question: Why is test_the_current_code_has_exactly_the_knobs_and_event_kinds_the_manifest_gives_it red on main?

evidence.note: Research Rf80c488bfd (CONFIRMED): parity test failed with 4 extra live lanes knobs absent from UM.replay(); fixed by declaring them.

ddflow brief --item fix-B6fae86acc5 returned the project rules; r-everything-configurable (every tunable is a declared knob) is the rule this fix enforces: the four lanes knobs + bugs.repro_runs were knobs with no manifest declaration. Loaded r-company-workflows, r-ddflow-self-assessment, r-everything-configurable, r-everything-managed, r-lock-cycle-selfheal, r-reuse-core, r-small-files.

Added 4 unreleased manifest fragments (knob_added.lanes.event_buffer=1000, lanes.pass_env=[PATH,LANG,LC_ALL,TERM,TMPDIR], lanes.scope="none", lanes.stop_grace_s=10) and knob_added.bugs.repro_runs=1, plus regression test tests/test_lanes_manifest_parity.py. Surface parity test (non-slow) 10 passed; UM.lint() clean.

chunk_findings.detail: The manifest files declare all four lane knob values as TOML strings: `new = "1000"` for `lanes.event_buffer`, `new = '["PATH", ...]'` for `lanes.pass_env`, `new = '"none"'` for `lanes.scope`, and `new = "10"` for `lanes.stop_grace_s`. TOML parsing therefore exposes `"1000"`, `"10"`, and the literal string contents (including embedded quote characters) as Python `str` values, not as `1000`, `10`, `"none"`, or a list. Running the added regression test fails at the first new assertion: `assert knobs["lanes.event_buffer"] == 1000` gets `'1000' != 1000`. Either the TOML values must be written as real typed TOML values (`1000`, `["PATH", ...]`, `"none"`, `10`) or the test must assert the string forms actually stored.
chunk_findings.title: tests/test_lanes_manifest_parity.py:17-20 and the four `knob_added.lanes.*.toml` files

data.probe: pytest tests/test_lanes_manifest_parity.py -q -> 1 passed. Manifest defaults are stored JSON-encoded then DECODED (upgrade_manifest._decode), so new="1000" decodes to int 1000, new='"none"' to str none, new='["PATH",...]' to a list; the assertion knobs['lanes.event_buffer'] == 1000 passes.
